name: server_info
title: Server information
description: Return bridge/runtime metadata, active policy, protocol versions, and available tools.

name: project_overview
title: Project overview
description: Summarize the connected workspace, repository root, local policy, and top-level entries.

name: session_bootstrap
title: Load session bootstrap
description: Load built-in working agreements, bounded automatic project facts, user-global and root workspace instructions, and capability refresh metadata for MCP session initialization.

name: resolve_task_capabilities
title: Resolve task capabilities
description: Rescan built-in and automatic project context, local instruction files, skills, registered commands, applications, and browser capability metadata; rank the capabilities relevant to the current task and optionally load the best skill.

name: list_local_applications
title: List local applications
description: Discover installed local applications and launchers without reading their document contents.

name: open_local_application
title: Open local application
description: Open a named local application, optionally with a document or URL target, using the operating system launcher.

name: inspect_local_application
title: Inspect local application UI
description: Inspect a bounded macOS Accessibility tree for a running application. Requires local Accessibility permission and never executes arbitrary AppleScript supplied by the caller.

name: operate_local_application
title: Operate local application UI
description: Perform a structured macOS Accessibility action on a matched UI element. Text can be supplied through a registered local resource so secret values do not enter MCP arguments.

name: browser_status
title: Browser bridge status
description: Start or inspect the loopback browser-extension bridge used to automate the user's existing Chromium profile, windows, tabs, and login state.

name: pair_browser_extension
title: Pair browser extension
description: Open the local pairing page and return the packaged unpacked-extension path for one-time browser installation and pairing.

name: browser_list_tabs
title: List browser tabs
description: List tabs from the paired user's existing Chromium browser profile.

name: browser_get_source
title: Read browser page source
description: Read bounded serialized current DOM HTML from the active or selected browser tab and optionally from all accessible frames.

name: browser_inspect_page
title: Inspect browser page
description: Inspect bounded interactive DOM metadata across accessible frames for links, controls, form fields, accessible names, labels, and roles.

name: browser_action
title: Operate browser page
description: Perform one structured navigation or DOM action in the user's existing browser tab without accepting arbitrary JavaScript.

name: browser_fill_form
title: Fill complex browser form
description: Fill multiple fields and optionally submit a complex form in one structured browser transaction. Sensitive values can come from registered local resources and are not returned.

name: browser_screenshot
title: Capture browser screenshot
description: Capture the visible area of the active or selected tab from the paired existing browser profile and return it as MCP image content.

name: browser_upload_files
title: Upload browser files
description: Populate a browser file input from registered local resource files without returning file contents through MCP results.

name: agent_context
title: Load agent context
description: Discover built-in defaults, bounded automatic project facts, Codex-compatible global/root-to-target instruction precedence, progressively disclosed local skills, and registered commands for a target path.

name: list_local_skills
title: List local skills
description: Search bounded SKILL.md or skill.md bundles from Codex-compatible and explicitly configured skill roots without executing them.

name: load_local_skill
title: Load local skill
description: Load one discovered local skill entrypoint and a bounded relative file inventory. Loading returns instructions and never executes skill files implicitly.

name: list_local_commands
title: List registered local commands
description: List commands registered by hierarchical .machine-bridge/agent.json manifests for the selected target path.

name: run_local_command
title: Run registered local command
description: Execute a named command registered in .machine-bridge/agent.json as a direct argv process without shell parsing. Manifest timeout and argument policy remain authoritative.

name: list_roots
title: List workspace roots
description: List filesystem roots exposed by the active local policy. The default full profile exposes local filesystem roots and returns absolute paths.

name: list_dir
title: List directory
description: List direct children of a workspace directory.

name: list_files
title: List files
description: Recursively list files under a workspace path with bounded traversal and output.

name: read_file
title: Read text file
description: Read a UTF-8 regular file or an inclusive 1-based line range. The server does not block sensitive-looking filenames; access follows the active local policy and operating-system permissions.

name: view_image
title: View image
description: Read a bounded PNG, JPEG, GIF, or WebP image from the workspace and return native MCP image content.

name: write_file
title: Write text file
description: Atomically write a UTF-8 file up to 5 MiB. Supports create-only and optimistic SHA-256 checks; symbolic-link destinations are rejected.

name: edit_file
title: Edit text file
description: Atomically replace an exact text fragment in one UTF-8 file. By default the old text must occur exactly once.

name: apply_patch
title: Apply structured patch
description: Apply a bounded Begin Patch/End Patch envelope containing add, update, move, or delete file operations. All paths are prevalidated and mutations are serialized.

name: search_text
title: Search text
description: Search UTF-8 text files under a workspace path for a literal substring.

name: git_status
title: Git status
description: Return bounded Git porcelain status for the repository containing a workspace path.

name: git_diff
title: Git diff
description: Return bounded unified Git diff with external diff, text conversion, and filesystem monitor helpers disabled.

name: git_log
title: Git log
description: Return recent commits in a bounded, machine-readable format. Author email addresses are omitted unless explicitly requested.

name: git_show
title: Git show
description: Return bounded metadata and patch output for one revision without running repository-configured external helpers.

name: run_process
title: Run process directly
description: Execute an argv array without a command shell. This avoids shell parsing but does not sandbox the executable or code it launches.

name: start_process
title: Start process session
description: Start a direct argv process without a shell and retain bounded stdout, stderr, and stdin state across MCP calls.

name: read_process
title: Read process session
description: Read bounded stdout and stderr deltas from a server-managed process session, optionally waiting briefly for new output.

name: write_process
title: Write process stdin
description: Write bounded UTF-8 data to a live process session and optionally close its stdin stream.

name: kill_process
title: Terminate process session
description: Terminate a live server-managed process tree with graceful or forced termination.

name: diagnose_runtime
title: Diagnose runtime layers
description: Run fixed, non-user-controlled local probes to distinguish MCP policy, local filesystem, process-spawn, shell, managed-job storage, and registered-resource failures. A successful response proves the request reached the local daemon; it cannot diagnose a host refusal that blocks the tool call itself.

name: list_local_resources
title: List local resource aliases
description: List names and validation status for locally registered file resources without returning their paths or contents. Resources are registered only through the local machine-mcp CLI.

name: generate_ssh_key_resource
title: Generate SSH key resource
description: Generate or reuse an Ed25519 SSH key pair on the local machine and register the private key file as a local resource alias. Private key content is never returned. Local paths are omitted unless expose_paths=true; fingerprint, permissions, and registration status are returned. Available only under canonical full policy.

expose_paths.description: Return local private/public key paths. Defaults to false.

name: stage_job
title: Stage managed job for local approval
description: Validate and persist a managed-job plan without starting any process. Use this when execution tools are unavailable or local operator review is required; launch later with machine-mcp job approve JOB_ID.

name: start_job
title: Start managed job
description: Durably accept a detached argv-based job with ordered steps, job-scoped temporary files, and guaranteed-attempt finally steps. The independent local runner continues if the MCP connection disappears. Use {{temp:name}}, {{resource:name}}, env_resources, or stdin_resource; registered resource contents never enter MCP arguments.

name: list_jobs
title: List managed jobs
description: List recent detached managed jobs and their lifecycle status without returning step output.

name: read_job
title: Read managed job
description: Return one managed job status plus bounded, resource-redacted step results. Registered resource paths and contents are never returned.

name: cancel_job
title: Cancel managed job
description: Request cancellation of a detached managed job. The runner terminates the active process tree and still attempts declared finally steps and local resource cleanup.

name: exec_command
title: Execute shell command
description: Execute a shell command with workspace cwd. This is not a sandbox and has the operating-system authority of the local user.
